extraction.Name: Jake Herman
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his 160 acre allotment at the time he got it, for he did not want to pay taxes; but that he accepted it on advice of the Indian Agency to do so
extraction.Buyer: sold to W.E. Kieffe, of Kyle, South Dakota, for $2000.00 cash, Mr. Kieffe paying the taxes
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: in 1920, the taxes being back on it, he sold it to W.E. Kieffe, of Kyle, South Dakota, for $2000.00 cash, Mr. Kieffe paying the taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: farms for a living, besides working for neighbors at odd times
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, has good health; married with a wife and two children to support; family has good health; has never received any help from the County or Government; sale occurred in 1920; affidavit sworn November 21, 1928, Shannon County, South Dakota
